Set on Linekin Bay with approximately 190 feet of owned water frontage, this 1901 shingle-style house has been carefully restored. Original woodwork survives through the front rooms, and the granite terrace looks straight down the bay toward the harbor. Deeded access to a shared float. Year-round road access; the property is winterized.
